title: fix(service-settings,cloud-connection)!: Branding settings drive runtime-config under single; theme_mode and support_email retire; namespace withheld under walled postures
body:
Fixes #24766

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What this implements

The maintainer's ruling B′ (`6293793948`) with its amendment (`6293825075`), under the standing rule 「甲」 (#6015 `6292005854`).

**Under `single`: runtime-config's `branding` block reads the Branding settings, per request.** `RuntimeConfigPlugin` (`packages/cloud-connection`) reads the `branding` namespace on every `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` (and the legacy alias), so a save shows on the console's and the sign-in page's next load:

| served field | settings key | fallback when nobody set the key |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `productName` | `branding.workspace_name` | host option, then `OS_PRODUCT_NAME`, then `ObjectOS` |
| `logoUrl` | `branding.logo_url` | host option, then `OS_LOGO_URL` |
| `brandColor` | `branding.accent_color` | host option, then `OS_BRAND_COLOR` |

- "Set" means any `source` but `default`: saved in Setup, or pinned by the settings layer's own `OS_BRANDING_*` variable. That is the same rule `plugin-auth` already applies to `workspace_name`, so the two readers of that key agree. The manifest default (`ObjectStack`) is never served on this door.
- Precedence decision, stated because the ruling names only the env vars: the host's constructor option sits with the env var as the deployment default, so a saved value outranks both. Pinned.
- `productShortName`, `pwaDescription` and `pwaThemeColor` follow the served name and colour unless configured themselves. Before, they were derived once at construction from the deployment values.
- `brandColor` keeps its one meaning: the console's browser and installed-app theme colour (objectui `getPwaThemeColor`), beside each app's own `AppBranding` colours. No precedence rule is added.
- A settings read that fails serves the deployment branding and logs one `warn` per run of failures. The door never answers 500 for it.
- The served `branding` block keeps its shape. No exported type or option changed: `RuntimeConfigPluginConfig` gained no member (JSDoc only).

**`theme_mode` and `support_email` retire, manifest version 1 → 2, in #21970's shape.** `branding.manifest.ts`, the four translation bundles and the README follow. `accent_color` also loses its `#6366f1` default: the page showed it as a colour the console never used, since an unset key is now served as the deployment's colour.

**`workspace_name`'s auth readers keep working.** `plugin-auth` still reads the key for sign-in mail, the authenticator issuer and MCP sign-in; its binding now runs only where the namespace is offered (see the patch-round section below). The key's description states both effects: "The product name in the console, on the sign-in page and in the browser title, and in sign-in emails, the authenticator app and MCP sign-in."

**Under `group` / `isolated` the server does not serve the `branding` namespace.** `SettingsServicePlugin` holds a manifest in `UNWALLED_ONLY_NAMESPACES` (today only `branding`) back at `init()`. It registers that manifest from its `kernel:ready` hook only when the posture in force puts up no organization wall. It reads the posture the way its own door and service already read it (`resolveAdmissionTenancyPosture`). It decides at `kernel:ready`, not at `init()`: during `init()` the `tenancy` service may not be registered yet, and `isolated` is in force only once `org-scoping` has registered. The registry's own answer then covers every door:

- `GET /api/settings` does not list `branding`;
- `GET` and `PUT /api/settings/branding` are refused `404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE` by the existing unknown-namespace path, never a silent 200;
- the runtime-config door reads the namespace only when the settings service lists it. Absent, it reads nothing, so no tenant data reaches that anonymous door, and the deployment's `OS_*` branding is served as before. No organization is resolved before sign-in.

A posture that cannot be read withholds the namespace and logs one `warn` naming it: offering is the one direction a guess must not take. No `tenancy` service, or a host with no async registry, offers it, which is how every lean kernel has always read the posture. `settings-service.ts` (claimed by epic #15194) is not touched.

**Walled deployments, the auth product name.** With `branding` withheld, `OS_BRANDING_WORKSPACE_NAME`, and an organization-less `branding.workspace_name` row, no longer name sign-in mail, the authenticator issuer or MCP sign-in; the `OS_APP_NAME` chain does. Operators move the value to `OS_APP_NAME`. This is stated in the service-settings and plugin-auth changesets.

### The retired-key refusal under 「甲」: confirmed

A save naming a retired key gets the loud refusal through the version step: `PUT /api/settings/branding` naming `theme_mode` or `support_email` answers `400 UNKNOWN_KEY` with `details: { namespace: 'branding', key }`, and the refusal covers the batch (a `logo_url` sent beside it does not land). Pinned in `settings-routes.test.ts` with stored rows seeded, and ablation-verified below. So the fallback (a warning in 18.x, with the refusal filed for 19.0) is not needed.

## Clause-② measured

`no (narrowing)`. Published types: `@objectstack/service-settings` exports the same symbols with the same types; only the value of `brandingSettingsManifest` changed. `SettingsServicePluginOptions` and `RuntimeConfigPluginConfig` changed in JSDoc only, and `RuntimeConfigPlugin` changed only in private members. The served `runtime/config` shape is unchanged. Narrowed accept sets, three:

- `branding.theme_mode` / `branding.support_email` on every posture (now `400 UNKNOWN_KEY`);
- under walled postures, the whole `branding` namespace (now `404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`);
- under walled postures, the `OS_BRANDING_WORKSPACE_NAME` override and any organization-less `workspace_name` row, which no longer name the auth product name.

 The ruling's "wiring the three keys is a widening" is the capability sense, which is why `@objectstack/cloud-connection` takes a `minor`. No published surface widens in the Clause-② sense.

**Cross-lane in this PR:** `packages/qa/dogfood` (`domain:cli`) for the fixture re-point, and `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx` (`domain:devx`) for the Configuration row. `content/docs/releases/` is untouched.

## The Setup entry and the auth binding (patch round 1)

- **The Setup → Branding entry moves with the capability.** `SettingsServicePlugin` contributes `nav_settings_branding` through the `manifest` service from the `kernel:ready` step that offers the `branding` namespace, and only then. It sits in Configuration at priority 110, after platform-objects' entries and before service-messaging's; the pattern is `@objectstack/mcp`'s `connect-ui.ts` (cloud ADR-0009). `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` drops the static line. `check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` boots the plugin through `kernel:ready` in a new roster entry, so the id stays in that gate's population: setup still 53 merged ids. Labels stay keyed `apps.setup.navigation.nav_settings_branding`.
- **plugin-auth binds `branding.workspace_name` only where the settings service lists the `branding` namespace**, the runtime-config door's test. A walled boot no longer logs `Auth: failed to apply branding.workspace_name: No settings manifest registered for namespace 'branding'.`, and the configured app name stays in force.
- `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` counts 31 Setup ids, exactly: that harness composes `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` and the MCP bundle only, and the Branding entry now travels with service-settings. It also asserts `nav_settings_branding` is absent there.
- Changesets are now four: `@objectstack/platform-objects` minor (`24766-setup-branding-entry`) and `@objectstack/plugin-auth` minor (`24766-auth-brand-binding`) join the two above. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is unchanged for the PR.

## Tests (head `0c71c4190`, after merging `origin/main` `644e4b2c5`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 56 files, 924 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 53 files, 625 tests passed.
- `typecheck` for both (`tsc --noEmit`, plus `-p tsconfig.test.json` for cloud-connection): exit 0. `--listFiles` shows both programs compile every new and edited test file.
- Importer spot-check (behaviour moved from `init()` to `kernel:ready`): `plugin-auth`'s `auth-settings-ordering.pin`, `auth-settings-seeded-boot.pin` and `dev-admin-seed-workspace-timezone` tests, 3 files and 12 tests passed. `plugin-auth` aliases `@objectstack/service-settings` to source.
- The dependency closures were built first (`turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cloud-connection... --filter=@objectstack/service-settings...`, 34 tasks).

New pins:

- `service-settings/src/settings-branding-posture.pin.test.ts` boots the real `SettingsServicePlugin` sequence with `tenancy` on a real `ObjectKernel`, and drives the real `registerSettingsRoutes` over the service it built:
  - under `group` and `isolated`: absent from the listing (the other namespaces are still listed); `PUT` and `GET` refused `404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`;
  - under `single`, with no tenancy service, and on a host with no async registry: listed, saved, read back;
  - a posture that cannot be read: withheld, one warning naming it.
- `service-settings/src/settings-routes.test.ts`: the two retired keys. Not offered and not resolved, even with a stored row. `PUT` refused `400 UNKNOWN_KEY` by name with the whole batch. A stored row never blocks a live save and is kept.
- `service-settings/src/manifests/branding.manifest.test.ts`: version 2; exactly `workspace_name` / `accent_color` / `logo_url` in `identity` / `appearance`; no retired key; no default on `accent_color` / `logo_url`.
- `cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-branding-settings.test.ts`:
  - under `single`: a saved logo URL is the one served, and an unset one falls back to `OS_LOGO_URL`; the same for the name (never the manifest default) and the colour;
  - the derived fields follow; a saved value outranks the host option; reads are per request; `source: env` counts as set; a failing read serves the env branding with one warning;
  - under `group`: the setting is not served and the door never calls `getMany`;
  - no settings service: unchanged.
- `settings-service.test.ts`: the #5204 env-override pins used `branding.theme_mode` as their example select. They now use `localization.locale`, also a domain-less select, and pin the same behaviour, as #21970 re-pointed its pins.

### Ablations (each negative pin, put back, seen red, restored)

Each used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with a literal anchor that must hit and restore proven by blob. Every restore ended "blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty". The test subjects resolve by relative import to `src`, so no `dist` rebuild was involved.

1. **Posture gate removed** (`if (posture !== undefined && postureEnforcesWall(posture))` became `if (false && …)`, blob `a282064cb1d8` → `5e3180ac9016`): 6 red in `settings-branding-posture.pin.test.ts`. They are listing / PUT / GET under `group` and `isolated`: `expected [ 'company', 'localization', …(2) ] to not include 'branding'` and `expected 200 to be 404`. Restored to `a282064cb1d8`.
2. **Door ignores the listing** (the `listManifests().find(…)` replaced by a constant manifest, blob `1cedb39aa721` → `88ff9db94c1d`): the walled-posture pin went red, `expected { productName: 'Tenant Org', …(6) } to match object { productName: 'Env Product', …(2) }`. Restored to `1cedb39aa721`.
3. **Manifest default served as set** (`if (!entry || entry.source === 'default') continue;` became `if (!entry) continue;`, blob → `f429c41343c8`): 3 red, `expected 'ObjectStack' to be 'Env Product'` (and `… 'Host Product'`). Restored to `1cedb39aa721`.
4. **`theme_mode` put back into the manifest** (blob `6e63f4cce79b` → `85c21c5efa98`): 7 red. The route pins answered `expected 'SETTINGS_VALIDATION' to be 'UNKNOWN_KEY'` and `theme_mode must not be offered`, the manifest pins failed, and the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES coverage reported `key:theme_mode` missing. Restored to `6e63f4cce79b`.
5. **Read memoized at the first request** (blob `1cedb39aa721` → `bff4ef12d8d3`): the per-request pin went red, `expected 'Env Product' to be 'Renamed'`. Restored to `1cedb39aa721`.

### Patch round 1 (head `e6522a957`)

- `service-settings`: full suite 56 files, 929 passed; `settings-branding-posture.pin` re-run at `e6522a957`: 15 passed.
- `plugin-auth`: full suite 173 files, 3319 passed, 10 skipped (before the test-only typing fix); `auth-plugin.test.ts` re-run at `e6522a957`: 112 passed; `auth-settings-ordering.pin`, `auth-settings-seeded-boot.pin`, `dev-admin-seed-workspace-timezone` passed.
- `platform-objects`: full suite 82 files, 1232 passed.
- `cli` unit project, the files that compose the Setup nav: 4 files, 70 tests passed (`connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin`, `platform-page-i18n-parity`, `adr-0048-app-split`, `format.server-ready-dev-admin-audience`).
- Typecheck exit 0 for `service-settings`, `plugin-auth` (with `check:test-typecheck`), `platform-objects` (with `check:test-typecheck`), `cloud-connection` and `cli` (with `check:test-typecheck`).
- New and changed pins: `settings-branding-posture.pin` folds the real `SETUP_APP` + `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` plus what the boot registered through the real `SchemaRegistry`: under `group` and `isolated` no `nav_settings_branding` in the merged Setup tree (controls `nav_settings_company`, `nav_settings_localization` present); under `single`, with no tenancy service, and with no async registry, exactly once in `group_configuration`, after `nav_settings_feature_flags`. `auth-plugin.test.ts`: walled pin (namespace not listed: no branding read, no subscription, no warn naming branding, `setAppName` never called) and a real-`SettingsService` pin (no branding manifest: unbound and silent; registered with a saved `Acme Single`: `setAppName('Acme Single')`).
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP; every restore "blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty"):
  - A. plugin-auth gate forced open: 2 red (the walled pin and the real-service pin, the latter showing the warn line). Restored to `9f496bd8c738`.
  - B1. Static line put back into `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS`: 5 red (walled postures: `to not include nav_settings_branding`; the three offering postures: `to have a length of 1 but got 2`). Restored to `ad98264e484d`.
  - B2. Posture gate removed: 8 red (listing / PUT / GET / Setup entry under `group` and `isolated`). Restored to `171c958f5702`.
  - C. The gate roster entry fires no `kernel:ready`: `check-app-nav-i18n` exits 1, "landed NO setup navigation id". Restored to `23f2ff594226`.

### Patch round 2 (head `d616d4d87`)

- **The dogfood re-point** (contract review item 10):
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/settings-organization-isolation.dogfood.test.ts` now uses `company.legal_name` as its tenant fixture. Run for real under the `isolated` posture it boots (its guard leg asserts posture `isolated`, degraded `false`): 6 passed.
  - Control leg: the file restored from `e6522a957` and run on the same code gives 4 failed, 2 passed. Three failures carry `{"code":"UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE","message":"No settings manifest registered for namespace 'branding'."}` (`expected 404 to be 200` twice, `expected 404 to be 400`), and the data-API positive control fails `expected false to be true`. Restored: blob `531e8f552e34` == HEAD.
- **The no-wall branding suites:** `settings-config-change-audit`, `settings-audit-global-rung-sibling` and `audit-log-parent-read-gate`, 3 files, 16 tests passed.
- **Typecheck,** all exit 0: dogfood, plugin-auth (`check:test-typecheck` OK), service-settings, platform-objects (`check:test-typecheck` OK), cloud-connection.
- **No ablation this round:** no mechanism file changed.

## Gates

- `dispatch-gates --commands` at the final head `d616d4d87` derived 106 commands; the 29 new ones come from the docs page and the dogfood path. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe: 104 exited 0. `check:skill-examples` (spec) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: missing dists) and re-ran exit 0 after building their closures ("262 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)"; "112 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load").
- `--ran` with exit codes: "106 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 106 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- The changeset gates at `d616d4d87`, each exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` ("1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition … not-required (no-migration-prescription)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, and the adr-0087 `--self-test` (548 assertions).
- Check Changeset was red on `acaf3231b`: a literal FROM/TO migration label tripped the ADR-0087 prescription detector. Reproduced locally (exit 1), reworded as the environment fix it is, and `success` on `d616d4d87`.
- Earlier rounds, still standing: `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:settings-bind-window` and `check:init-service-contract` exit 0 at `0c71c4190`; `pnpm check:app-nav-i18n` exit 0 at `e6522a957` (setup: 53 merged nav ids).
- ESLint over the dogfood test: exit 0. Control-byte scan of the round's files: no hit.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, `runtime-config-boot-read` step 1 (`logoUrl` / `brandColor` only when configured by the plugin config or env vars): a saved Branding setting now serves them too, under `single`. Its namespace count is a `single`-posture count; under a walled posture `branding` is not served. QA text drift, not edited. Carrier: none.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/settings-organization-isolation.dogfood.test.ts` uses `company.legal_name` as its tenant fixture, because `branding` is not offered under the `isolated` posture it boots.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/anonymous-door-sweep.classification.ts` classifies `runtime/config` as "no tenant data". Under `single` the door now serves the one organization's saved branding, which the ruling defines as the deployment's. Under a wall it serves none. The wording still reads true by the ruling's definition. Carrier: none.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts` keeps `CONDITIONAL_SETUP_NAV_IDS = ['nav_sso_providers']`, the ids whose labels must stay although no single composition contributes them. `nav_settings_branding` is now such an id (contributed only under `single`) and could join it. Carrier: none.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts` says its roster mirrors `check-app-nav-i18n`'s CONTRIBUTORS. The new service-settings entry contributes one `url` item, which that file (object-entry views) has nothing to judge, so its verdict is unchanged. Carrier: none.
- On a multi-tenant host that resolves environments by hostname (`env-registry`), the branding read is the host kernel's own settings, process-wide, exactly as `OS_PRODUCT_NAME` was. Per-environment branding was never served here and still is not. Carrier: none.
- `workspace_name`'s manifest default `ObjectStack` still differs from the console's built-in `ObjectOS`. That is the two-defaults reading #24887 carries for the operator docs. Carrier: #24887.
